opening.argument: The video directs viewers toward buying Hedget through an auction and FTX-linked participation process, presenting concrete steps rather than merely discussing the token. It explains how to participate, including KYC2, sub-account creation and funding, while the auction guide shows bid quantity, bid price, collateral, wallet registration and MetaMask interaction. The solicitation is reinforced by advice to use higher bidding, a one-hour payment window, and a first-come, first-served event. It also links immediate investment to a claim that participants will receive about 100 tokens and describes the opportunity as one to make a profit. The presenter’s disclaimer and wallet-safety warning limit conclusions about intent, losses, or completed outcomes, but they do not remove the described purchase and token-benefit solicitation.
